reviews.review: I tried this game in 2024 because I thought that surely it couldn't be that bad, but oh it is. This may be one of the worst AAA games I have ever played. Its hard to sit through the awful dialog and facial animations of this game. The story is stupid and unbelievable, and the UI is a mess. The shooting is good, sort of, but there is nothing carrying it. I am astounded that the same team who made Mass Effect 3 before this was able to make a game worse than a high schooler using Unity.

Encountered three bugs in a span of initial 45 minutes in game, followed by a crash-to-desktop.

Story is predictable, shallow and hastily written at best (outright garbage at worst).
Movement feels sluggish, UI is clunky, facial animations are absolute disaster.
Premise of the game is exploration of a different galaxy, but your main antagonists are hominid bipeds and a generic android race, very creative… oh and by the way, everyone speaks perfect english, in a different galaxy, upon first contact, right. 

The game goes out of its way to either retell the same stories as the trilogy, or outright ignores certain dilemmas of the original lore (such as Citadel race's stance on AI, Genophage..). In other words, lore and background story lines at best retread the same ground, and at worst disrespect the well… originals. 
The fact that all of the dialogue at the best of times compares to the “big stupid jellyfish”, without the memeable potential, does not help at all. 

Only thing which had any potential was the revamped RPG/combat loop, with a bigger (and dare I say better) class system than ever before… until you realise that at any given point you can only utilise three skills at once. I wonder which genius came up with that, but here we are. 

Everything about this game screams unfinished, thoughtless and unapologetic cash grab made in the management boardrooms rather than actual writers or game designers… which is a damn shame,

Amazing game, and a great combat experience. There is a rich history and backstory in this game. It was fun learning and reading about it. You can tell that a great deal of love and effort went into this game. With that said there are also a few things I ended up not liking about it. 

1. There seems to be a heavy homosexual influence on this game that I couldn't really avoid. 
2. Too much back and forth between systems to finish quests.
3. It's easy to lose track of the story for the quest you're on.
4. I enjoyed the hell out of this game but I don't see myself replaying it much since I can't skip the cut scenes or flaming stuff.
If you're a fan of the Mass Effect franchise, this is a good game. Think of it as a spinoff, not part of the original trilogy. Large open areas, good story. What you'd expect from the game overall.
